responsibility: Provides rustc_type_ir’s shared collection and utility layer by defining the module’s common hash and index-preserving map/set aliases, feature-gated helper utilities such as stack growth support, reference-counted pointers, and small map/set stand-ins, and by exposing delayed-caching map/set wrappers that start with cheap small-case behavior and switch to hashed storage when collections grow so type IR code can use efficient common data structures across both small and large workloads.
